scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Whew...!
Still, he won't eat anything unless it's Meat. But maybe he will eat fruit if it was cut so that it was easy to eat. Like, if it was blended into juice...
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
呼...！
不過，除非是肉，否則他什麼都吃不下。但如果把水果切成容易吃的樣子，他也許會吃吧。比如，把它打成果汁...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Ah! Come to think of it, I heard they were making fruit juice somewhere. Now where was it... Payon Village, or Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
啊！說起來，我聽說有人在製作果汁。是在哪裡來著...斐揚村，還是莫洛奇？

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Eat some fruits!! You don't want to become a slobby fat pig when you grow up, do you?
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
莫里森！！吃點水果吧！！你難道不想長大後變成一隻邋遢的肥豬嗎？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Hm? ...You!
You're the one who gave, my little Morrison that Meat?! Did you come here thinking I wouldn't know about it?!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
嗯？...就是你！
就是你給了我兒子莫里森肉吃？！你以為我不知道嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Go away, get out of my house NOW!!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
滾開，馬上給我滾出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! I'm going to be very very mad if you keep doing this!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
莫里森！！如果你再這樣下去，我會非常非常生氣的！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Oh!!.... This...
what is this...??
How could you do something like this to my boy?!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
哦！！.... 這...
這是什麼...？
你怎麼能對我的兒子做這種事？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Argh! Get out of my house right this instant!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
啊！馬上給我滾出我家！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Please eat some fruits!! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
莫里森！！請吃點水果吧！！拜託了~！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marinaa]
Sigh~!! Like father, like son...
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗娜]
唉~！！真是有其父必有其子...

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
*Sigh*... This is Morrison...
My one and only son.
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
*嘆氣*... 這就是莫里森...
我唯一的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
But these days, he just won't eat fruits. His face is so dull because he refuses to eat healthy. He just wants to eat Meat. I need to find a way to feed him fruits or vegetables....
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
但最近，他怎麼也不肯吃水果。因為拒絕吃健康的食物，他的臉色看起來很差。他只想要吃肉。我得想辦法讓他吃點水果或蔬菜....

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! You're going to be in big trouble if you keep this up!
scripts.translation:
[主婦 瑪麗安]
莫里森！！如果你再這樣下去，你就大禍臨頭了！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Bleh... Forget it.
I'm just going to shrivel to death just eating fruits. Don't bother worrying about me .
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
呸... 算了。
光吃水果我遲早會餓死的。別為我擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ah... so full~
I think I can live now.
You don't have to give me any more Meat. I feel like I'm going to explode if I eat any more.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊... 好飽~
我覺得我現在能活下去了。
不用再給我肉了。再吃下去我感覺自己要爆炸了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Oh... and... um.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哦... 還有... 那個。
拿著這個。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
It's a little something I've been saving to eat for later, but since you gave me Meat, I think I can pass on the sweets.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
這是我留著以後吃的點心，但既然你給了我肉吃，我覺得我可以把這些甜點讓給你。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Agh....Noooo!!!
No, don't make me eat it! I can't bear to taste fruits!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊.... 不！！！
不，別逼我吃！我受不了水果的味道！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Show the Meat
scripts.translation: 出示肉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaagh!! Once or twice is enough!! I refuse to eat any more fruits! You have to peel them and there's so much juice that it makes you feel icky...
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊啊啊！！一兩次就夠了！！我拒絕再吃水果了！還得剝皮，而且汁水太多，吃起來黏糊糊的...

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
And they're all slippery and sour... Even if I eat it, I still feel hungry. Aaaah~! Give me Meat!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
而且它們又滑又酸...就算吃了，我還是覺得餓。啊啊啊~！給我肉吃！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ooh! M-Meaaat~
Ah... hu...hungry...
The scent of Meat...
Excuse me...
C-can I please have one?
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
噢！肉...肉~
啊...好...好餓...
肉的味道...
打擾一下...
能...能給我一塊嗎？

scripts.text: Give Meat
scripts.translation: 給肉

scripts.text: Don't Give Meat
scripts.translation: 不給肉

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Wow~!!! Meat!!
So yummy!
Thank you,
I think I can
live now.
*Chew chew*
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哇~！！！肉！！
太好吃了！
謝謝你，
我覺得我
活過來了。
*咀嚼聲*

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Waah...!
Fine, I get it now.
Adults are all the same!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哇啊...！
好吧，我明白了。
大人都是這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaaah!!! No matter what, I'm not going to eat fruits and vegetables!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊啊啊！！！無論如何，我都不吃水果和蔬菜！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Welcome.
Did you come to
process fruits as well?
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
歡迎光臨。
您也是來
加工水果的嗎？

scripts.translation: 製作果汁

scripts.text: Talk and get information about fruit processing.
scripts.translation: 交談並獲取水果加工資訊

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

What kind of fruit juice would you like to make?
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
您想製作哪種果汁？

scripts.text: Apple Juice
scripts.translation: 蘋果汁

scripts.text: Banana Juice
scripts.translation: 香蕉汁

scripts.text: Carrot Juice
scripts.translation: 紅蘿蔔汁

scripts.text: Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. To make {0}, I need 1 {1} and 1 Empty Bottle. I will also need a 3 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
哎呀...
您沒有備齊所有材料。製作{0}，我需要1個{1}和1個空瓶。另外還需要3 Zeny的手續費。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
When you have prepared everything, I will blend the fruit to give you delicious juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
當您備齊所有材料後，我會將水果攪拌成美味的果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
How many would you like?
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
您想要多少？

scripts.text: As many as I can.
scripts.translation: 儘可能多

scripts.text: I want a certain amount.
scripts.translation: 指定數量

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Choose a number less than 100. If you don't want to, put '0'. You can make up to {0} bottles of juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
請輸入100以下的數字。如果不想製作，請輸入“0”。
您最多可以製作{0}瓶果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
More than 100 bottles is impossible. Choose a different amount.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
超過100瓶是不可能的。請重新選擇數量。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. I can't help a situation like this. I guess you collect what you need.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
哎呀...
您沒有備齊所有材料。我幫不了您。看來您得先去收集所需的材料了。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Here you go! Fresh and delicious juice as promised. It should be very refreshing and palatable.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
給您！
正如承諾的那樣，新鮮美味的果汁。喝起來一定很清爽可口。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Before humans were able to develop such vast societies, they gathered fruit from trees to survive. Fruits may have been nature's blessing that allowed us to exist in the world.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
在人類能夠建立如此龐大的社會之前，他們靠採摘樹上的果實生存。
水果也許是大自然賜予我們的恩惠，讓我們得以在這個世界上生存。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Since life became so prosperous, the younger generation seems not to eat fruit any more. So, I started thinking of ways to make fruit easier to eat.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
自從生活變得富裕起來，年輕人似乎不再吃水果了。
所以，我開始思考如何讓水果更容易食用。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
I realized that when you make fruit juice, it's more convenient to eat and has a much better taste.
scripts.translation:
[商人 馬克斯·漢森]
我發現，把水果做成果汁，不僅食用起來更方便，味道也更好。
